title: Abram and Lot Separate

questions.question: Why did Abram and Lot need to separate?
options: The land could not support both
questions.correctAnswer: The land could not support both
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:6: The land could not support both of them dwelling together.

questions.question: What did Abram generously offer Lot?
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:9: Abram let Lot choose which direction to go.

questions.question: Which direction did Lot choose?
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:11: Lot chose the Jordan Valley and journeyed east.

questions.question: What city did Lot settle near?
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:12: Lot moved his tent as far as Sodom.

questions.question: Where did Abram settle after they separated?
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:18: Abram settled by the oaks of Mamre at Hebron.

questions.question: What was the conflict between Abram and Lot?
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:7: There was strife between their herdsmen.

questions.question: Why was the Jordan Valley attractive to Lot?
options: It was well-watered like the garden of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: It was well-watered like the garden of the LORD
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:10: The Jordan Valley was well-watered everywhere, like the garden of the LORD.

questions.question: What was the moral condition of Sodom?
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:13: The men of Sodom were wicked, great sinners against the LORD.

questions.question: To what did God compare Abram's future offspring?
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:16: God said He would make Abram's offspring as the dust of the earth.

questions.question: What did God tell Abram to do after Lot left?
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:17: "Arise, walk through the length and breadth of the land."

questions.question: What peoples were dwelling in the land during Abram's time?
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:7: The Canaanites and Perizzites were dwelling in the land.

questions.question: What did Abram build at the oaks of Mamre?
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:18: Abram built an altar to the LORD at Hebron.

questions.question: From where did Abram return when this chapter begins?
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:1: Abram went up from Egypt into the Negeb.

questions.question: How wealthy was Abram described as being?
options: Very rich in livestock, silver, and gold
questions.correctAnswer: Very rich in livestock, silver, and gold
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:2: "Now Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold."

questions.question: What directions did God tell Abram to look?
questions.explanation: Genesis 13:14: "Lift up your eyes and look... northward and southward and eastward and westward."

key_verse_text: 'for all the land that you see I will give to you and to your offspring forever.'
